dashboard.emptyText: ETS2 and ATS servers will appear here with status, load and power controls.
dashboard.quota: Your quota: {{used}} of {{total}} servers, RAM {{mem}} of {{memTotal}} MB.

agent.unavailable: The panel cannot reach its agent. Check that the agent container is running.
agent.failed: The agent reported an error. See the task history for details.

moderator.invalid_link: Paste a steamcommunity.com profile link or a SteamID64.
moderator.duplicate: This player is already a moderator of this server.
moderator.lookup_failed: Steam did not answer. Try again later or paste the SteamID64.

discord.not_configured: Paste a Discord webhook URL first.
discord.webhook_invalid: Discord does not accept this webhook: it was deleted or the URL is wrong. Create a new webhook in the channel settings and paste the URL again.
discord.rate_limited: Discord is rate limiting requests. The panel will retry.

discord.rejected: Discord rejected the message. See the panel log for details.

steamcmd.failed: SteamCMD could not install the server. The cause is in the last lines of the task log ("Log" button).

profile.email_taken: This email is already used by another account.
profile.steam_not_linked: Link your Steam profile in the profile settings first.
profile.current_session: This is the current session — use "Sign out" for it.

quota.exceeded: Your quota does not allow another server. Ask the administrator to raise it.

user.self_change: You cannot change your own role or disable or delete your own account.
user.owns_servers: This user owns servers. Transfer them to another owner or delete them first.
user.invite_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask the administrator for a new one.

member.not_found: No active user with this username or email.
member.duplicate: This user already has access to the server.
member.owner: The owner cannot be removed or demoted — transfer the server first.

backup.invalid: This is not a TruckPanel backup or the archive is damaged.
backup.game_mismatch: The backup was made for another game.
backup.quota: Backup space is used up. Delete old backups or ask the administrator to raise the limit.

schedule.limit: This server already has 10 schedules, the maximum.

servers.title: Server
servers.name: Name
servers.nameHint: Shown as the session name in game (up to 63 characters). Always 128 slots.
servers.createInfo: The panel picks free ports and downloads the dedicated server with SteamCMD (about 1.3 GB).
servers.subtitle: Connection port {{connection}}, query {{query}} · 128 slots
servers.slotsNote: 128 slots: SCS officially states a limit of 8, so the server logs the warning "Proper player limit exceeded" — this is expected and the server works. To see the server in the session browser, players set uset g_max_convoy_size "128" in their own config.cfg.

packages.why: The dedicated server needs server_packages.sii and server_packages.dat, which only the game can export. They define the map, DLCs and mods.
packages.step1: Enable the game console in the game config.cfg:
packages.step2: Start the game with the DLCs and mods you want and load a profile (the map must be loaded).
packages.step4: Upload both files from "Documents/Euro Truck Simulator 2" (or American Truck Simulator) here.
packages.restartNeeded: The server is running: restart it to apply the new packages.
packages.noHistory: None yet: every replacement keeps the previous pair here (up to 5 versions).
packages.rollbackText: The pair from {{time}} becomes current. The current files are kept in the history.

tasks.logHint: "flock /sys/devices/virtual/dmi… errno = 13" lines are a harmless SteamCMD warning inside the container; the panel hides them. The cause of an error is in the last lines of the log.

console.readOnly: Server output (read-only). The SCS dedicated server does not accept console commands; moderators manage the session in game.
console.empty: Empty: the server has not run yet.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.text: Delete the server with its game files and configuration. Its ports are released.
danger.confirmText: This cannot be undone. Type the server name "{{name}}" to confirm.

session.title: In-game session
session.persistentHint: The server logs in to Steam with a logon token, so its session search id stays the same between starts.
session.temporaryHint: Without a logon token the server logs in anonymously and gets a new search id on every start. Add a token to make it persistent.
session.step2: Create a token for the GAME app id (not the server):
session.step3: Paste the token here. Each server needs its own token.
session.tokenReplace: Token saved — enter a new one to replace it
session.restartNeeded: The server is running: restart it to apply the token.

config.intro: server_config.sii settings. The server reads them only at start, so changes apply after a restart. The panel keeps every version.
config.readOnly: You cannot change the configuration — read only.

general.title: Session
general.desc: How the server appears in the session browser.

gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.desc: Collisions, damage and how players are shown.

lobby_name.label: Session name
lobby_name.desc: Shown in the session browser. Up to 63 characters.

welcome_message.label: Welcome message
welcome_message.desc: Shown to players when they join. Up to 127 characters.

password.label: Session password
password.desc: Empty = open to everyone. Up to 63 characters. Stored encrypted.

player_damage.label: Damage from players
player_damage.desc: Players can receive damage from other players.

hide_in_company.label: Hide players in companies
hide_in_company.desc: Remote players are hidden in company areas.

hide_colliding.label: Hide colliding after teleport
hide_colliding.desc: Hide a colliding vehicle after teleporting.

in_menu_ghosting.label: Ghost while paused
in_menu_ghosting.desc: Disables collisions while a player has the game paused.

max_vehicles_total.label: Vehicles total
max_vehicles_total.desc: SCS default is 100. SCS does not document the allowed range.

max_ai_vehicles_player.label: AI vehicles per player
max_ai_vehicles_player.desc: SCS default is 50. SCS does not document the allowed range.

max_ai_vehicles_player_spawn.label: AI vehicle spawn per player
max_ai_vehicles_player_spawn.desc: SCS default is 50. SCS does not document the allowed range.

mods_optioning.label: Optional mods
mods_optioning.desc: Mods marked as optional are really optional for players.

timezones.label: timezones
timezones.desc: Allowed values 0–2. SCS does not document what each value means; the server generates 0 by default.
timezones.tooltip: The SCS wiki describes this setting only as the range "0–2".

fixed.title: Managed by the panel
fixed.desc: The panel always sets 128 slots, the connection and query ports, the logon token ("In-game session" card) and the moderator list ("Moderators" tab). friends_only and show_server are not used by the dedicated server.

config.passwordKeep: Password set — leave empty to keep it
config.passwordWillClear: The password will be removed on save
config.saved: Configuration saved. It applies at the next server start.
config.restartRequired: The server is running. Restart it for the changes to take effect.
config.restartBanner: Configuration, moderators or token changed after the server started.

moderators.title: Session moderators
moderators.intro: Paste a Steam profile link or a SteamID64. The server promotes these players automatically when they join; moderators can change the time (/set_time) and rain (/set_rain_factor) via chat.
moderators.applyOnRestart: Changes to the list apply after a server restart.

players.title: Players online
players.name: Player
players.source: Built from the server log (connect/disconnect lines). The server does not log SteamIDs.

dock.noActivity: Finished tasks appear here: installs, starts, stops.

discord.title: Discord message
discord.intro: The panel posts one status message to the channel and keeps it up to date. Every server has its own message, even when the webhook is shared.
discord.webhookHelp: Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL.
discord.webhookKept: Webhook saved (id {{id}}). Leave the field empty to keep it.
discord.webhookSetPlaceholder: Saved — paste a new URL to replace it
discord.sectionsHint: Status and players N / 128 are always shown.
discord.notifyStatus: Separate message when the server starts or goes down
discord.notifyStatusHint: In addition to the main message: "back online" / "unavailable".
discord.removeTitle: Remove the message and the webhook?
discord.removeText: The status message is deleted from the channel and the webhook URL from the panel.
discord.urlFormat: This is not a Discord webhook URL. It must start with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Username, password, language and theme, Steam profile and active sign-ins.

password.title: Password
password.hint: Changing the password signs out all other sessions.
password.saved_one: Password changed. {{count}} other session signed out.
password.saved_other: Password changed. {{count}} other sessions signed out.
password.saved_few: Password changed. {{count}} other sessions signed out.
password.saved_many: Password changed. {{count}} other sessions signed out.

preferences.title: Language and theme
preferences.hint: Stored in your profile and applied in any browser after sign-in.

steam.title: Steam profile
steam.hint: Link your Steam account to become a session moderator on servers with one click.

invite.title: Invitation to TruckPanel
invite.intro: Account "{{username}}". Set a password to sign in.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Accounts, roles and quotas. Users create their own servers within the quota and share access themselves.
users.deleteText: The account and all its sessions are deleted. Users who own servers cannot be deleted.
users.roleHint: Administrators see and do everything. Users see only their own servers and the ones shared with them.
users.inviteText: Send this link to the user to set a password. It works once and expires on {{time}}.
users.inviteWarning: The link is shown only once. If it gets lost, create a new one — the old one stops working.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitleAdmin: Everything that happens in the panel: sign-ins, server, user and settings changes.
audit.subtitleUser: Actions on the servers you own.

members.title: Server access
members.intro: Add a panel user by username or email and pick a role. The owner manages access and can delete the server.
members.transferText: "{{username}}" becomes the owner of "{{server}}". The server counts towards their quota; the previous owner stays as a manager.

backups.title: Server backups
backups.intro: The newest {{keep}} are kept. Before a restore the panel makes a safety backup of the current state.
backups.contents: Contains server_packages.sii/.dat, config_ds.cfg, server settings and moderators. Game files are not included (SteamCMD reinstalls them). No secrets: the logon token, session password and Discord webhook stay as they are.
backups.restoreText: Server files and settings return to {{time}}. The current state is saved as a separate backup.
backups.restoreRunning: The server is running: it is stopped and started again after the restore.
backups.deleteText: The archive is removed from the server for good.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.intro: Actions run automatically. If the server is busy with another task at that moment, the run is skipped. Runs missed while the panel was down are not caught up.
schedule.noWarning: Updates run only when Steam has a newer build. Players cannot be warned in game: the SCS dedicated server accepts no commands.
schedule.autoRestartHint: At most 3 attempts in 10 minutes; after that the server stays in the error state.
